interpretation: The support-only patch is plug-compatible with official GAS and can change final closed-loop success without retraining the policy. On this near-saturated smoke env, mild penalty=2 produced a small ep20 gain (0.97 to 0.98) but increased mean episode length (248.7 to 261.95). Strong penalty=8 degraded ep5 success. Treat this as a promising but not yet conclusive transfer result: the useful regime is calibrated soft risk, not hard pruning or large penalties.
